title: Draft upload-slot filter re-encodes document_upload's canonical slot-name whitelist
detail: document_upload is the canonical owner of upload-slot names (private is_known_field plus pub *_key() fns whose docs forbid re-encoding the strings); draft_handler hardcodes a second copy. Adding or renaming a document slot silently drops it from the draft filter, drifting the name-level no-documents guarantee.
recommended_fix: Export is_known_field (or a slot-name list) from document_upload and call it from draft_handler.filter_fields; delete file_slot_names/coapplicant_slot_prefixes so the whitelist has one source of truth.

title: Vacancy+draft lookup preamble triplicated across the SSR draft handlers
detail: Three handlers repeat the same 6-line vacancy-lookup + friendly-404 + lookup_draft nesting (a distinct site from the round-1 N6/N7 duplication). AGENTS.md's DRY rule says extract helpers when logic repeats in 2+ places; the nesting also drives the deep indentation the module criticised for elsewhere.
recommended_fix: Extract one helper, e.g. use #(vacancy, draft) <- with_vacancy_and_draft(req, config, code, token), returning the shared 404/500 responses, so each handler keeps only its divergent success logic.
